title: R Systems surges on a huge volume spike

timeline.title: R Systems surges on a huge volume spike
timeline.line: Stands out against a weak tape, trading about ₹529 cr in value as the IT stock jumps
more: Reports put the gain between 7.7% and 17.8% (intraday high ₹301.65)
Monday's delivery volume was 35 times the five-day average
No company announcement has been cited yet
